newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Mapfre to buy 51 pct of Venezuela's La Seguridad.
newsitem.headline: Mapfre to buy 51 pct of Venezuela's La Seguridad.

text.p: Mapfre International, an affiliate of Spain's largest insurance group Corporacion Mapfre, is negotiating a majority stake in Venezuelan insurance company Seguros La Seguridad, high-placed sources told Reuters.
"Under the deal, Mapfre will become the largest shareholder while Banco Provincial retains the second largest share," the source, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
Seguros La Seguridad, an affiliate of Inverserca, is Venezuela's largest insurance company. Banco Provincial, with a 37.85 stake in La Seguridad, is Venezuela's largest bank.
"Within the next 30 days, La Seguridad is also going to increase its paid-in capital, and that will consolidate Mapfre's and Provincial's positions within the company," the source said.

Mapfre said earlier this year it was seeking to expand operations in South America after strong 1995 results saw net profits reach 9.57 billion pesetas ($77 million). Some $50-70 million were budgeted for investments in Peru and Venezuela.
